data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 给朋友的手信
data.description: 小店的货架上摆着各色手信。蕾娜拿起一个布包，看过图案后又看看旁边的另一款，认真挑给朋友的礼物。
data.action: comparing two small cloth gifts on a shelf
data.promptProse: Inside a quaint folk craft shop filled with lacquerware and wooden dolls, Lena thoughtfully compares two handcrafted patterned silk pouches, holding them up against the warm window daylight. Polished wooden shelves, woven bamboo baskets, and the gentle chime of glass wind bells create a cozy, nostalgic shopping atmosphere.
